description: Reference durations and resource budgets for ASHFALL builds, gates, and audits. Checked by scripts/ci/timing-budget.py: a stage running 30% or less over its reference is tolerable; strictly more than default_tolerance_ratio (1.30) is flagged SUSPICIOUS and means investigate and optimize the test, not raise its budget. References are authored/recorded values, never an automatically-updated live ledger. Keys are gate ids as emitted by run-gates.py --report-json, so the check actually matches. Every entry carries its measurement context (see measurement_context).

measurement_context.host: AMD Ryzen 5 7530U with Radeon Graphics (integrated GPU)
measurement_context.measurement_rule: Every budget entry records load_at_start, free_mem_at_start_mb, and threads. Wall-clock references recorded under concurrent-session load (load average ~14-24) are worst-case upper bounds; quiet-tree medians are authoritative and supersede them once recorded. Peak RSS is comparatively load-insensitive and is recorded directly. Advisory load observed 14-24 on 12 threads = 1.2-2.0x oversubscription, which inflates wall times but not peak RSS.
measurement_context.memory_ceiling_note: Memory-sensitive stages (compiler_warning_baseline, build_godot_host, build_core_tests) peak at 1.2-2.3 GiB on a host with ~2.2 GiB free; they are memory-bound as well as compiler-bound.
measurement_context.renderer_note: Integrated GPU means frame-capture runs can land on llvmpipe software rendering; record the renderer with every frame measurement.

compiler_warning_baseline.note: Three deliberate `dotnet build -t:Rebuild -m:1 -p:UseSharedCompilation=false` runs; incremental builds emit no warnings so Rebuild is required to avoid a false pass. Duplicates build_core_tests + build_godot_host. Peak RSS 2273 MB is the host rebuild.

build_godot_host.note: dotnet build Ashfall.csproj. Huge variance: 3.8 s no-op vs 139.4 s cold/full; the reference is the worst case so a no-op does not trip it. Compiler-bound (one ~616 K-LOC assembly).

docs_index_drift.note: python3 scripts/ci/generate-docs-index.py --check over 4,159 files / 4.199 GB, uncached. CPU-bound (42.9 s user / 68 MB peak RSS); caching target of Track B. Key renamed from the legacy 'docs_index_check', which matched no gate id.

build_core_tests.note: dotnet build Ashfall.Core.Tests. Authoritative reference stays 41.82 (quiet); the 120.6 s committed worst case is recorded in observed_seconds and is NOT used to raise the reference (it is the open 2.9x load/concurrency question).

real_campaign_journey.note: Godot headless --real-campaign-journey-selftest; engine-startup bound. Language conversion cannot help.

coverage_gate.note: coverlet instrumentation over the CLR; conversion infeasible.

port_contract_gate.note: python3 scripts/ci/generate-port-contract.py --check; corpus scan, Track B cache candidate.

plan_integration_audit_drift.note: python3 scripts/ci/generate-plan-integration-audit.py --check; corpus scan, Track B cache candidate.

doc_link_portability.note: doc-link-gate.sh; markdown corpus scan, Track B cache candidate.

architecture_map_drift.note: generate-architecture-map.sh --check; corpus scan, Track B cache candidate.

ui_panel_contracts_test.note: dotnet test --filter UiPanelContractTests; build+CLR per filtered run; Track C --no-build reuse candidate.

audio_cue_integrity_gate.note: dotnet test --filter AudioCueIntegrityTests; build+CLR; Track C --no-build reuse candidate.

campaign_envelope_fuzz_test.note: dotnet test --filter CampaignEnvelopeFuzzTests; Track C --no-build reuse candidate.

plan_register_check.note: Ad-hoc stage (python3 scripts/ci/generate-plan-register.py --check); not a run-gates gate id, so it is checked only when supplied explicitly via --key.
